families.name: loxilb_ai_tokens_consumed_total

families.verification_evidence: docs/internal/METRICS-COVERAGE-GAP-RCA-AND-PLAN.md section A.3; WP-2's red twin is the no-usage backend that drives exactly this branch

families.name: loxilb_ai_tokens_missing_total
